verdict.rationale: In-product AI insights are a fair axis for a data orchestration platform, but the evidence shows no AI-generated insights or suggestions inside Dagster itself. The Dagster+ MCP server exposes deployment data to an external AI session, and the dagster-expert skill guides coding agents. Both are adjacent building blocks or external-agent features, not in-product AI insights from the user's data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
